drivers.text: Group revenue growth of 454% was driven by capacity scaling with higher pricing and improved utilization; the AI cloud business was about 98% of group revenue, and the Microsoft contract tranches have all been delivered.

Q2 was the strongest commercial quarter: management cites four deals averaging more than $1 billion total contract value, roughly 70% of deals with customer prepayments, and contract value per MW above $20 million; most deals relate to capacity arriving in late 2026 and revenue mainly in 2027.
D&A rose 245% mainly on GPU-related capital expenditures and data center hardware; useful life for servers and networking was lengthened to five years from four.

Q2 capex of about $5.7 billion went mainly to GPUs and data center expansion; funding sources include operating cash flow, over $9 billion of expected 2026 customer prepayments, secured debt and an at-the-market equity program.
Interest expense jumped mainly because of convertible notes issued in June 2025, September 2025 and March 2026.

gaps: capex_guidance: the release defers detailed guidance to the call (line 612: 'will share a detailed view of guidance on its earnings call'); the deck text says FY2026 guidance reiterated and 50-60% of capex self-financed, but no capex dollar guidance is in the files.
rpo_next_12m_pct: only 36% within the 24 months ending Jun 30 2028 is given; no 12-month share.
useful_life_change: the stated earnings impact is not in the 20-F or release text searched (searched four to five, reduction in depreciation).
contracted_power: only year-end 2026 target (5 GW) and prior indication (+4 GW) found; the deck graphic (lines 98-105 of part2) shows a progression chart but no current actual figure in text.

largest-customer share: Customers A to E are not named in the filing, so mapping to Microsoft or Meta is not stated; Customer C held 83% of accounts receivable at Dec 31 2025, Customer E 29% and D 16% at Jun 30 2026.
cloud_segment_op_income_q: no segment operating income found in the parts read (AI cloud adjusted EBITDA 285.7 is non-GAAP); segment note not read in full.
Nebius files 6-K/20-F; 'quarterly_*' 10-Q does not exist, so Q2 figures are from earnings_q2_part1-4 (parts 1-4 read selectively), all unaudited.
Nebius column order in the release is 2025 then 2026 (prior year first); balance sheet is Dec 31 2025 then Jun 30 2026.
Interest expense is net of capitalized interest per MD&A; capex line also includes intangible assets, so it is not strictly purchases of PP&E.
